input.evidence: The boxed cow is standing side-on, with her rump to the left and her head up on the right, inside a tight group of 3 to 4 cows in the middle of the pen. In the zoomed looks at 0 s and +10 s, I saw no head-to-head pushing, butting, licking or mounting. A white-faced cow stands in front of her and partly blocks the view. Across the frames from -25 s to +25 s, she stays in about the same place and is not at the bunk or the waterer. The chew check found no rhythmic chewing (0.38 Hz, peak-to-median 2.1).
input.self_check: I checked her over time (4 frames from -25 s to +25 s, a zoomed look at +10 s) and ran a chew check. I'm going against the tracker's 'social_interaction' label, which may have come from the cows overlapping closely rather than from any real contact. This would be wrong if there was brief contact while the white-faced cow blocked the view. Who is in the box is also unclear because the cows overlap. The footage is infrared, so I couldn't judge ears, nose discharge or breathing.
